question: mi waddi bingel am mudu biji nayi nyautolde hanne nyaluwa mi leli bingel on siroso wudenayan goddon amma bosaran gatimo de be waddi jokale on wuro be hi ti'an kofeti mira buti fude reto bosaru en gati shukale on mita yi fudere non wuti bo buti mi wadi yamdede bo ken dirabe mo an di bosaru nganya tibingel on jon bosaru don wui be meda hokku go bosaru on jibnen de be wi dun yahai yasi dun fija dun warta tun be wi be meda hokku go bosaru dun nikki sun kanjum wadi mi holi sai mi yahai waddugo bingel on nautorde ngam to bosaru dun ngati tukale on no wawi no wodi no bosaru dume hebata bingel go bosaru ngati bo dume wawi hiba futere wujjudum e buti dum nyau bana nyau bosaru wawi nasta der futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sabbun ngati bosaru on si ko dume mi wawi wadugo ngam to nyaunata futere on dume jun nande e lekki hani hokka bingel on ngam hiba jam ko dume goddo mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi wadango futere den de bosare don ngati bingel
reference: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. De ɓe waddi cukaley on wuro ɓe hecci am ko fayti , Mi raɓɓuti futtere to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on,Mi tawi futtere non wujji bo ɓuuti.  Men waɗi ƴamde  dere keddiraɓe mo andi bosaaru nga ƴati bingel on. Joom bosaaru ɗun wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru on Njibinanɗe .Ɓe wi'i ɗun yaha yasi dun  fija ɗu warta tan. Ɓe wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru ɗun lekki sam. Kanjum waɗi  mi huli se mi yaawi wadduko bingel on Nyaurdorde, gan to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on no wodi ƴau bosaaru . Ɗume  heɓɓata bingel ko bosaaru ngati bo?  Ɗume wawi heɓɓa  futtere wojju ɗun e ɓuutu ɗun? Nƴau bana ƴau bosaaru waawi nasta dere futere? Ko waawi waɗɗuko bingel on sabun ngati bosaaru on? Tii, ko ɗume mi waawi waɗɗuko ngan to nƴau nata futtere on? Ɗume Njibinanɗe e lekki haani hokka bingel on gan hebɓe Jam? Ko ɗume goɗɗum min waawi waɗɗuko wala ko lekki min waawi waɗɗanko futtere ɗen to bosaaru ɗun ngati ɓingel on?
model_answer:
Bingel lewruuji nayi (4 months) to woni e bosaru/yarsude, a yahdu mo nautorde/asibiti hannde, sabu o waawi heɓde ɗoyngol ndiyam (dehydration) ko yaawi.  
Tee e ɗamtugo/ɗokkugo nono no feewi; so a heɓii ORS, hokku mo ɗooɗum-ɗooɗum caggal kala bosaru.  
So ORS alaa, waɗ ndiyam laaɓɗam lita 1 + shukare cuɓe 6 + gishiri cuɓel heewaani (½ teaspoon), hokku ɗooɗum-ɗooɗum; hoto waɗ lekki wuro walla lekki dartinirɗo bosaru.  
Zinc 10 mg ñalnde kala haa ñalɗi 10–14 wawi wallude, kono dokita/ma’aikacin lafiya yo hollu dose.  
So fuɗɗere hoore naatii, hunduko ɓorni, o ɗamataa, o yaltataa pissi, o waɗi ngulɗi, ƴiƴam e stool, walla o tampii/no hoyi—ɗum ko gawat, yah asibiti jooni.

question: dai bo je jodata hasari amin o huwa dowada kugal mako bo o wala nyawu yande fere wakkati o do yi wa o nane en e mako do mari hunde petel satinga hada o numi wala ko dume o nani wala ko dume o lari o nani dum fahim nyande fere fahim do wakkati o dillai o fuddi numugo be mai sosai o fuddi numugo de mai on ha en e nyaku wala nyamugo molana wamo amma babali mai o sati bo sali dillugo o fuddi tum bo labari je ingol robbe je mari dum ha'i ndi naddi sati je sali o yahi larugo likita o yidi o anda dume on dasi dum de dumi on o wadata hala mai mdejema mdejemako mi on dasata hunde mai ha'i en idi bo ko mi onje satinga ha'i en i'o nagansa mi on de bolora talara fahim ha'i en imai
reference:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako  boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali,  o yeti larugo likita.  O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga  ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
model_answer:
Ko on kaaloton ɗum no wa’i ko **majjum fahim/haala majjere** caggal hasara; ɗum waawi ummaade e **jorɗe hoore/ɗamol e nder hoore**, walla nyawu goɗɗo (malaria, sugar, stroke, infection).  
Alamaaji ɗi—o nani/yi’i ko wonaani, o haala labari ngoonga wonaa, o sali nyaamude walla yahude asibiti—**ko haɗari**, hoto on ɗabbin.  
Ɗillinee mo jooni to **asibiti/likita** ngam a ƴeewta BP, sugar, malaria, infection, e hoore (CT-scan so woodi).  
Haa on yaha, woppitee mo e jam: wota o ɗow motor, wota on hokka magani/alcohol tawa likita yamira, ndeenee mo e hoore mum.  
So o fainti, o heɓi seizure, o ruufi, hoore muusii no feewi, walla o waɗi ɗemngal/violent, noddee gargaɗe jooni.

question: jabore dum mo dum e safa neto teteti mo diri di lebbiji di'i ke dure makowai nga dimo nyawu do be am mi dai wi'i reduma fana mo dum dum e wi'i enko e wuti leya samako e o inna e o woya ngawna en bon kodi sembe mako sawa en makko biben sara en makko bi e don kodi tawi mutawa dada ko mungel dun yamde arandere de nyauto yami nyamde diga beren dume hani wadi gobela wo hade borede wojo on nyamre teta wure dume hanira bute go hefta nyamdun damreno yauren ero nde kikiya hani nyamderemo damrejo yauren ero nyamden di'a owadato bebo ero gendam dayayya hani of ujira

Debbo reedujo mo dubi sappane tati e tati mo wodi reedu lebbi jeeɗiɗi keddu en makko ngaddimo Nyaurdorde amin. Ɓe wi'i  reedu mako no nawɗum tenduɗum, ƴiiyan ko ɗuɗi wurti le yeso mako. Ii 'o diwna ,I'o woya ngam nawɗun dun ɓurimo semɓe.  Saro en makko mbii be don kultori ta godɗun tawa Dada ko bingel ngel.

Ƴamnde arandere nde Nyautowo ƴami :  dume on wadi reedu naawurta non ha ma ƴiiƴam wurto e sembe?
Ƴamnde ɗi dabre: Dume haani waɗugo ɓelau ha debbo reedujo on?
Ƴamre tataure: Dume haani raɓɓu tugo hefta nyau dum?
Ƴamre Nayabre: Irin lekki kiye haani nyaudiramo?
Ƴamre Joyabre: ira Nyamdu nduye o woɗoto, nden bo ira ngendam dayeejam haani o hutira?
model_answer:
Ɓinngel ngal no holli alamaji bonɗi: sembe ŋakkude, woyde, salaade muynude/nyaamde, yaltugol/dogol walla nguleeki; so ngal ko les lewruuji 6, ngardu ngal asibiti/jawdi jooni.  
Hadi on yotta, jokku muynugol nono inna seeɗa-seeɗa; hoto hokkugo haako/leppi walla magani tawa dokita yamiraaki.  
So dogol walla yaltugol no woodi, hokkite ORS seeɗa-seeɗa, kono ɓinngel les lewruuji 6 ena foti yiyde nurse/dokita.  
So ngal ɓuri lewruuji 6, hokku nyaamdu molɗum: koko/akamu, shinkafa/tuwo mo laaɓi, supu, ayaba, kosam/nono e ndiyam laaɓɗam.  
So ngal waɗataa fitsari, hunduko maayi, henndu tampi, nguleeki ɗuuɗi, walla ngal sala nono—ɗum ko gila asibiti.

question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
reference:
Jam bandu likita, useni mi waddi bingel am sibiti gam mi laari no o foofata, don woni bana sawtu hendu do saala babal petel ni, donbo bana goddo don fuufa hunde, be daker o foofata. Mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta odo dojja be jamma. Wakati fere mido lara berde mako do nasta sosai lugga, do fa’a do sosai bana saito naftiri sembe mako o foofata. Milaribo owala yaama banaane.
To o yammai fu saito onangi fofde mako. Irin bani mai don hokkatamo bone odo kasa yamugo boddum balle tati jotta. Mi arti mi yari mo chemist petel ha fattude amin, be hokkimo lekki dojjugo gam odo dojja sedda sedda, amma dojjugo mai hallai .
Amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafimo.
Foofugo mako bannin ni, kuma harjotta o wawata yamugo boddum. Useni irin damuwa toidamata mingel am be foofugo mako do bana hendu do saala babel piitum?
Useni o haadini hooto na? Heba famta ko daamata mo be kwadi berde mako do fada jippa do?
Irin yaudigi toi mihokkata mingel do ha sare, hoininamo heba o foofa boddum?
Don irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataaki je hosata hado bingel do?
model_answer:
Jam, ko a siftii ɗum ina wayi e **caɗeele fofugo**: fofugo yaawngo, ɓernde/ɗaɓɓude ɗo nasta, sauti bana hendu, bonna jemma, e waawde nyaamugo—ɗum ena waawi wonde **asma/bronkiolitis walla nimoniya (pneumonia)**.  
**Njaaɗu mo asibiti jooni**, sabu o ena waawi waɗde sokla **oxygen**, nebulizer salbutamol, walla lekki nimoniya caggal ɗe ɓe ƴeewti mo.  
Hoto jogii e lekki kemis tan, hoto hokku cough syrup walla ganye; ɗum ena waawi bonnude fofugo mako.  
Ɗo laawol, waɗ mo no o jolii, hokkir **njaram/nonno seeɗa-seeɗa**, hoto ɗon tilna nyaamugo, yaltin mo e hayaki, kura, turare, e dabbunde.  
To o waawaa yara, leɓɓi mako ɗo ɓuuɓa, o ɗo dogoo, o ɗo henna sossai, walla ɓernde ɗo nasta—**ɗum ko gawat, njaaɗu asibiti ɗoon-ɗoon**.

question: goɗɗo ɓe noddata subeeru duuɓi makko cappanɗe joyi nyannde ngon feere o fuɗɗi ƴowru arannde bo ƴowru ɗum yaaɗaayi ammaa nde ɗum faɓɓi asaweejo seɗɗa tan yaarugo lebbi ɓe hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum halloyi nde neeɓi seɗɗa sey ɗum saldoriimo poppe ɗum goonga on o haɓdi bawɗe ko o waawata hinde ko nyawuru ɗum sataayi ammaa ɗum pat manjum ɗum waɗaayi nde hannuno o nyamɗita ƴowru tolliti nde o hillitii dow o yaha o sooda lekki dikka o yaha nyawdorde o yi'a nyawtoowo nde o yokki nyawdorde o hecci ɓe o ɗo ɗujja lebbi tati ko saali o lori fayin o hecci ɓe o haɓdii ko o waawata waɗugo bana ko yimɓe shaawari mo ko laarani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum kaɗɗu heɓele ki ɗuuɗi ke ko o suudi dahaanuno o nyamɗita sell njomuru wari tulliti ɗunyotte ke wakkati feere fofo gomahe saldaromo ganjowuro ɗum nyaaɗi se o ƴami nyawtawo on ko waɗi nyowuru ɗum neeɓiri bane ni salu nyamɗitugo o yiɗi o anda ko waɗi dabareji ɓe leɗɗe ɗe o fuuɗi fuu nafayi ragaro men o ƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowuru ɗum ɗum nyamɗita fuumaru ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lornita jam ɓandu makko
reference:
Goɗɗo ɓeno data Suberu, duɓi mako sappaɗe joyi, ƴande fere ofuuɗi ƴowru. Arande bo ,ƴowru ɗun ƴaaɗai amma  de ɗun faɓɓi asaweje seeɗa tan yarigo lebbi, be hakkiilo ni ɗun yehi ɗun Halloi. O lori  fa hin ,o hecci ɓe o habdi ko wawata waɗuko bana ko hiɓɓe shawarimo ko larini jumri, diyan fowuɗan ,goroju-kaɗɗu,e ɓe lekki ɗuɗuki ko o soodi . Da hanuno ,O nyamɗinta se ŋyowru wari tulliti. Ɗun yottaki wakkati feere, fofugo ma e saldoramo ngam ŋyouru ɗum ƴaɗi . Se O ƴami Nyautowo on ,ko waɗi ƴowru ndum neɓir bana ni,sali yamɗutuko. O yinno o anda ko waɗi dabareji be leɗɗe ɗe o foodi fu ko nafayi .
Ragare mai ,on nƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru dum ɗu nyamɗita dufuumaru ,ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani  o lorinita jamo bandu mako.
model_answer:
Maande ɗe a sifii—poppe/ɓandu saldude, foofde saɗude ɓurta nde o ɗaani, tampere, salo nyamdugol e hakkillo waylude—ɓuri hollude ndiyam mooftiima nder ɓandu sabu ɓernde, kidini walla hanta ngalaa gollude no haani; ɗum wonaa nyawu ƴowru seedaa tan.  
O foti yaade nyawndorde mawnde jooni, ngam ɓe ƴeewta BP, jini, sukari, urine, kidney/hanta tests, ECG/X-ray/ultrasound/echo.  
So foofde saɗii, hakkillo waylii, walla saldorde ɓurtii, ɗum ko gorko emergency—o waawi heɓde oxygen e lekki yaltina ndiyam bana furosemide, kono ko nyawtoowo tan foti hokde.  
Hoto o yaaru alcohol, hoto leɗɗe gargajiya/lekki dikka, hoto nyamdugol ko ɗiɗɗi solɗam; ɓeydu himo ɓe walla o ɗaani dow pillows ngam foofde.  
Dabare ɓurnde ko ƴeewtere nyawtoowo, sabu waɗde lekki e suudu alaa ƴeewtere waawi bonnude kidini walla hanta.

question: dada debboje danye nebai wari sibiti o bi tun bingel mako danye o dauta rufe iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako den bo mo danyi mai dubi mago nogas e nayi o bi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo ko ɗume dembe am kanjum dume on waddata debbo dinga rufugo iyam ɗo bawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaudiiku toy ɓe hokkata dada mai jey rufugo iyam may darata den bo o lorna sembe mako shawara toy hokkata dada may ɓe ɓingel mako am
reference:
Dada debbo je dayi nebai wari sibiti . Ovi tun bingel mako dayi odota rufa eyam sosai.
Kanjum wadi owala sembe ha bandu mako.
Debbo mo dayi mai dubi mako nogas e ni. Ovi bo rufugo eyam mai duudi masin denta bo watamo owala sembe.
Daada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodume.
Demde am kanjum dumedon waddata debbo ninga rufugo eyam do bawo o dayi balde sedda sali do? 
Yaudiku toi be hokkata daada mai je rufugo eyam mai darata denbo olorna sembe mako? Shawara toi hokkata daada mai be bingel mako?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko haala jampirde: debbo ɓernde/rewɓe reedu ngam lebbi 9 so o rufii ndiyam sosai, sembe wala, maa o waawi nawnude (dehydration), malaria, infection, pre‑eclampsia/BP, walla bone ɗo ɓiɗɗo.  
On yahdu mo jooni siɓiti mawɗo ɗo ɓe jogii likita/ungozoma 24hrs, ngam ɓe ƴeewto BP, fitsari (protein/ketone), sukari, malaria, electrolytes, e ɗemngal ɓiɗɗo.  
So o waɗi hoore naange/ɗiɗi, gite yi’ata, ɓernde/juulde ndimbii, yowita, reedu metti, ƴiiƴam/ndiyam jaltude, walla ɓiɗɗo waɗataa hursinde—ɗum ko emergency.  
Tawi no yahata, hokku mo ORS walla ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa, kono woto on hokkir mo ganye/ɗemɗe ko ɓe anndaa.  
A siɓiti ɓe waawi hokkude drip, magani dartinde rufugo ko hisi e reedu, e toppitorde neɗɗo e ɓiɗɗo makko.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
reference:
Dottijo gorko warini Amin sibiti, goddo vii, odo nana hore mako donaawa. Daade mako do tiidii, be kuma foofe per peton vurtino ha bandu . Owari emugo dume don waddata irin do be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo. Min emmi goddo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warinimo na ko sedda sedda warinimo. Dottijo mai vi warinimo jamma denbo halli jotta. Min emmi mo bo odo laara hiite na? Ovi aa gam hiite o tullinamo naawol hore. Min emmi mo fu hala foofe ha bandu mako ko do naawa sosai ko sedda sedda. Dottijo mai vi foofinimo pat bandu bo kuma o wawata viyuwa da pelel gotel amma do nyanya mo.
Bawo kanjum min emmi mo ko o fotti be nyado . Ovi wala ha oyahi, banda sorrugo hunde ha yeso sare mabbe.
Dembe amin ha likita kanjum don kowaddata nyawol hore be daade tiidata do har o wala waylita daade, be foofe ko hatoi ha bandu mako? Dumewaddatadum? Ye’u je raabata donnaa or hundeji fere? Dembe am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en andata lallai kohebimo, heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirita bako jabargo vurta?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko **nyawu tiiɗɗo no wa’i e meningitis** (ɓekkitanol/moƴƴugol ɗiɗi ɗiɗi heɓa huunde ndee: naawol hoore, daande tiiɗɗude, fowru/jontino, ɓandu nawa, ɗoon e pelle/peteeji e ɓandu).  
Meningitis ina waawi raɓɓude hakkunde yimɓe, ɗum waɗi ngam ko waɗata **ka sibiti ɗon ɗon**, doctor’en ngoodi waɗa: bincike ɗii (jini, malaria test, full blood count, blood culture) e **lumbar puncture** ngam ƴeewde ndiyam ɓernde/CSF so alamaaji ina yamiri.  
So ko meningitis, lekki ɗum ko **antibiotic IV no ceftriaxone** (ko cefotaxime) ko ɗum fuɗɗata ko fewndo sabu waɗde jokkondiral; paracetamol, ndiyam drip, e reedu foofde/pressure maɓɓe.  
Yimɓe ɓadiiɗɓe mako (ɓesngu/ɗiɗo ɗoɗɗi) ina foti heɓde **lekki kariya** (misal ciprofloxacin/rifampicin/ceftriaxone) so doctor tabbatar ko meningococcal meningitis.  
Hoto ndaaron ka suudu: daande tiiɗɗude e naawol hoore ɗum ina waawi wonde haɗari, o yaaha sibiti tiiɗi/doctor jooni.

question: debbo laari gorko maako debbo laari gorko maako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira be do leso mai ni dojjugo nonnon ni fuɗɗata o neeɓa ni bako dara balɗeji o waɗa ni o laari gorko maako o yara bone foofugo to o yaaɓi seɗɗa ni ko o fa'i scal o do dara lorna foofɗe maako nden bo o do yawa soomugo be lau don nyande gorko maako neɓi o do ɗojja be o do haɓda lorna foofɗe ɗami debbo may o fuɗɗi numugo ko ɗon nyawu je waddata damuwaji jango may sai o volwini gorko mako be yaha asibiti ɓe lara likita heba ɓe hefta ko damata on ɗemɗe may ɗume on waɗata ɗuttugo kalnuɗi bannin be yawugo somugo be fofugo dakere ɗo damuwa ɗo wawan ko shafi ɓerɗe na ko yanko shafi ɓerɗe hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko tsarna goɗɗo bone fofugo harje goɗɗo mai handiri dasa hakkilo yauɗiɓe alamaji kalnuɗun je damuwaji fofugo je derdiraɓe handi lara hakkilina je tsugo be fofugo da kerɗum
reference:
Debbo lari gorko mako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira bedo do leso maini. Dojjugo nonon ni fuddata, oneba ni bako dara. Baldeji owada ni o lari gorko mako o yarabone foofugo . To o yapi sedda ni ko ofa’e eskal , odo dara lorna fofde mako , denbo odo yawa sommugo be lau. Don yende gorko mako neebi odo dojja be odo habda lorna fofde , daami debbo mai. Ofuddi numugo ko don ye’u je wattada damuwajido . Jango mai sai o volwini gorko mako beyaha sibiti be laara likita, heba be hefta ko daamata mo. Demde mai, dumedon waddata dojjugo kalnudum banni be yawugo somugo, be foofugo daker do? Damuwa do wawan ko shafi balle na ko ye’u ko shafi berde?. Hundeji toi don watata goddo maya ko yarna goddo bone foofugo, harje goddo mai hadine dasa hikkilo yaudibe?
Alaamaji kalnudum je damuwaji foofugo je dardiraabe haadi laara, hakilina je dojjugo be foofugo daker do?
model_answer:
Alamaji ɗi—lorna foofde, sembe ŋakki, ɗojja/soomugo, yawugo, walla mettuɗe kirji—wawan wonde nyawu ɓernde, nyawu hendu/kirji (pneumonia, asthma/TB), anaemia, walla sickle-cell crisis; ɗum no haani o yaha asibiti hannde, wonaa jango.  
So foofde makko no tawi, kirji/ɓernde no metti, o waawaa yahde seeɗa, o siddi, leɓɓe makko mblaa, walla o naasa ƴiiƴam—ɗum ko emergency.  
Likita maa ƴeewto BP, oxygen, ECG, X-ray kirji, ƴiiƴam, malaria/anaemia/TB, ngam heftinde ko woni sabu.  
Hade o heɓa likita, o jooɗo ɗow, o acca doggo/yahugo, sigara/giya, e dawaaaji ɗe likita yamiraani.  
Eey, ɗum wawan shafa ɓernde, sabu ɗuum waɗata ko ɓe foti yi’a jaawngal.

Ɗum ko ɗaɓɓitannde jawdi: zazzabi e gite/balli ɓen woni yalo-yalo, ɓinngel waawataa nyaamde walla yaraade, sembe wala—ɗum ena waawi wonde malaria mawɗo, hepatitis, walla jontinooje ƴiiƴam.

question: ɓinngel am waɗi reedu duuɓi makko wudala so henayi kanko mo woodi reedu ko feeti hannde bo jeema mi yisi o ɗo woodi nawuɗo o arti o mofti kare makko o wari wuro am non ɓeydi nde mi laari nawuɗo makko daraayi mi mofti kare makko arannde kam o yiɗa mi yaara mo nyawdorude mi yaari mo nyawdorude ɓe laari mo ɓe wi'i remirde makko fuɗɗi no maɓɓito nden wakkati o danyol maɓɓito nden wakkati o danyota ɓadi haa jotta kam danyoyi makko no ɓanti fa wakkati kon cukale on wurtoyta inga keenya kam cukale on no nane nawuɗo nawuɗon ndon ɓedota hammi jotti o wondi nawuɗon cukale makko wurtayi ridu makko arande on hakkilo am ummi ɓene am de itake mi yiɗi mi yida ɓinge am mi yiɗa mi soya ɓinge am ge warta du useini ɗume fodata nawudon on non dayodan arande wa'ina no fodata de wi'a ɓinge fotayi wurta hide alaura ko baɗon seka mo

model_answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaji haɗayɗe: harniya/ɓurtol reedu nde waɗi koɓol, naange, maɓɓito walla reedu ɓanti—ɗum ina waawi waɗude “strangulated hernia” walla toŋŋere ɓernde reedu, ko haɗari.  
Alaa jam faa njooɗon; yahaa e asibiti mawɗo jooni-joni, to doktor/likita jaraajo walla surgeon laara mo, sabu ina waawi waɗude opreshon yaawngon.

Ko ɓe waɗata ko opreshon ngam naatnude ɓeɗe reedu e feewtinde ɗo ɓurtol ɗon ummii, ngam haɗde reedu maayde walla ɓinngel waɗde caɗeele.

Debbo dayi bingel. Bingel mai leuru jew ko saali. Owadi bayani hala bingel mai, ovi wala damuwa do bingel mai wakati odayi mo, bingel mai do musina sosai bana no haadi,  bani tan o laari bingel mai do wooka naudum ha juude be kostejimako.

Ɗum waawi wonde ko **sikila (sickle cell) – hand-foot syndrome/dactylitis**, sabu ɓiɓɓe ɗi lewru 5–6 no mbaawi fuɗɗaade naawre e ɓamtaare juɗe e koyɗe.

Likita yo ƴeewto mo: genotype/Hb electrophoresis, jini, malaria, e ko ɓamtaare/naawre ɗon iwi.  
Haa nde ɗon yahaa, hokku mo nono/ndiyam, paracetamol ko ɗum yahdi e kilo mako; hoto waɗu magani gargajiya walla ñaamdu/taɓɓude juɗe e koyɗe.  
So o heɓii fepere, o yalaa no feewi, o salii ñaamde, o ɓoyli, walla o ɗon hengoo ngam doole, ɗum ko **gaggawa**.

question: debbo laari gorko maako ɗo mari nawol hoore nawol hoore may foɗai sam sam nawol hoore ɗo ɗo naawi ni har senda daande maako o teddi ni wawata waylutugo nanu be nyamo ni bana o handi se o laari kuulal ɓamari je walano ɓandu gorko may amma fuɗɗi vurti nonnon ɗum hulni debbo may ɗo irin kujeji fe'i dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on laati huunde may vurti kuma ɗume on o waɗata ko mi emi debbo may ba gorko ma komeɗi marugo zazzaɓi nawɗum na bekuma lekkitoy be naftiri ofii a a ko gorko may lesowo ɗanata ɗo pilow dawai ba o ɗani dow dandi mako ba ofii a a dani dow dandi mako ba nonnon nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tiddol dandi kuma pulel perpetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu mako ko irin kuje bannin fedi dume ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata wallititta gorko mako be lorninamo ɓandu bana no wonno

Sai o laari puulel pamari je walano bandu gorko mai amma fudi vurti nonon. Dum hulni debbo mai do irin kuje je fedi do bandu gorko mako, dume don laati hunde mai vurti, kuma dume don owadata? Ovi aa.  Ko gorko mai, leso o naanata, do pilo dawai ba o naani do daade mako ba? Ovi aa. Dawai ba o naani do daade mako ba nonnon naawol hore mai wari, sai wardi be tiidol daade. Kuma pullel per pertel vurtinimo ha bandu mako.
Ko irin kuje bani fe’di, dume don irin Debo do wadata vallititta gorko mako be lorninamo bandu bana no wonnon?

Ɗum ena waawi wonde **sankarau/meningitis**, sabu zazzaɓi, naawol hoore mawngol, tiddol/naawol dandi, jaɓɓugol lekki alaa nafaani, e kujeji fe’i dow ɓandu ko alamaji haɗari.  
Debbo on **woni haani yaarugol mo asibiti jooni-jooni**; ɗum wonaa nyawol ɗo lekkitaare suudu tan, sabu ena waawi waraade walla waɗde leydi hakkille.  
Hoto on ɗon ɗaɗa ɗum e lekki goɗɗi walla ɗaɓɓitaare bokiti, tee hoto o huuɓo e yimɓe heewɓe.  
No yahata asibiti, on wallit mo ɗumɗude ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa so o waawi, on waɗ mo ɗo leydi ɓuri himma, tee on waɗ ko dandi mako ɗo no o yiɗi hoto on faynira mo.  
Likitoci maa waɗu jarribol e fuɗɗo **antibiotic/ceftriaxone** law, ɗum woni ko ɓuri haɗani mo.

question: daada peju ɗon mari ɓikkon tati peju ɗon petel may peju ɗon mari duuɓi gotel daada peju may hirliti ɓawo ɓalɗe seɗɗa nde o danyi peju ɗon mari nyawu dojjugo kuma tun wakkati may o ɗo ta ojja wala darugo sam o wi kuma o hirliti fofugo fu ɗo hokka mo bone o wi ɗojjugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be kikkiɗe wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗana o wi fofugo mako ɗo sadinamo o fofata boɗɗum kam ɗojjugo ɗo wala accamo o fofa o wurtina boɗɗum o wi o yahi haa nyawdigo gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwinimo se o wi o dilli tan o yahi asibiti heba ɓe hefta ko fe'ata be pejum damuwa ɗo wawan hoyina ɓingel ɗo na damuwa ɓerde na ko asima ɗon fe'ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toy ɗon hanɗi ɓingel ɗo hanɗi acca heɓa ko damata mo waɗinta mo o ɗojja hoyina mo usta sosai
reference: Daada  peju, do mari bikkon tati, peju don petel mai . Peju domari dubu gotel. Daada peju mai hirliti bawo palde sedda dai odayi . Peju do mari ye’u dojjugo, kuma tun wakati mai odo ta dojja wala darugo sam . Ovi kuma o hirliti foofugo fu do hokkamo bone.ovi dojjugo do yawanchi do warinamo be kikkide  wakati komai fu nasti do naana. Ovi foofugo mako do sadina mo ofoofa boddum. Kam dojjugo do wala acchamo o foofa o vurtina boddum . Ovi oyahi ha yaudiko gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwunimo. So ovi odilli tan oyahi sibiti heba be o hefta ko fedata be peju. Damuwa do waawan hoyina bingel do na? Damuwa berde na ko asma don feddata be bingel do? Kujeji toi don haadi bingel do haadi accha, heba ko damaatamo wadintamo o dojja hoyinnamo, usta sosai?
model_answer:
Ɓinngel duuɓi gootel no hirlita, no ɗojja/yiɓɓa, no fofa doole walla no weeɓi, ko **alama haɗari**—ɗum waawi wonde malaria bonɗo, pneumonia, meningitis walla dehydration.  
Hokkude lekki gargajiya woodaani ndee; **yahee asibiti jaajum** ngam ɓe waɗa gwaji malaria, jini, sukari, ɓe hokku mo lekki, ruwa IV walla oxygen so waɗi.  
Damuwa ɓernde ina waawi hoynude neɗɗo, kono ɗum tan alaa sembe waɗde ɓinngel hirlita; asthma ɓuri waɗde fowru/huɓɓugo ɗum, wonaa hirlitagol.

Kowadi odo somi kullum do? Dumedon waddata silligo akai akai do? Do sembe eyam mako bamti don waddata ye’u do, ko diyam bandu mako timmi na, ko kujjeji fere don tan? model_answer:
Ɗee alamat ɗi a faamnii—yarugol ndiyam sosai, sillugol/fitsari akai‑akai jemma e ñalorma, jumri/tampere—ina ɗaɓɓi “jeyan shuga” (diabetes) haa ko ɗum tabitina, kono infection fitsari walla matsala koda ma ina waawi.  
O yahdu asibiti/PHC hannde walla jaango; aƴe **Random/Fasting blood sugar, HbA1c, fitsari sugar/ketone, BP, e gwajin koda**.  
To sugar mum ɓuri, likita maa waɗan magani goonga (metformin walla insulin) e tsarin kulawa; hoto/herbal ko magani suudu woto o fuɗɗo ko alaa gwaji.  
Haa nde o yi’a likita, o yar ndiyam laaɓɗam, o acca zaki/soft drink/juice/ti shuga, o ɓamta nyamri: ganyen miya, wake, kifi/nyama, e o famɗina tuwo/shinkafa/gari.  
To o ɗo yuyra sosai, o ɗo amai, ciki mettude, numfashi no yaawi, walla o ɗo sumorii, ɗum gawatiri—ngar asibiti jooni.

question: redujo wari sibiti kikkiɗe ɗo sey o wi gorko maako ɗo holina mo akai akai ɓe ɗo dufa mo kullum o wi ɗo wati mo o dinga hurtugo nyalanɗe ɗuɗɗum to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sey o ɗo hurtira ngam o ɗo dami ta o tappan mo ko o huɗan mo o hirliti fuu ɓerde mako ɗo dogga ɗo fiya o dilli hawnugo sembe iyam mako sey o tawi ɗo wa'i sey o wi'i o tori ballinde ha saare mako be o yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo wanni mo bayani ko fe'ata kanjum ɗon saare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam ɓawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa hurturgo sosai ɗon to ɗo hota saare ko to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta ɗume on o waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓerde mako wala jam e hakkilo
reference:
Reedujo wari sibiti kikide do, sai ovi gorko mako do hoolinaamo akai akai be do doofa mo kullum. Ovi do watimo odinga hurtuluggo. Yalaade dumdum to onani gorko mako do warta saare ko to onangan lawol sare, se odo hurtila gam odo daami ta o tappamo ko o huda mo.
O hirliti fuu berde mako do dogga, do fi’ya. O dilli haunugo sembe eyam mako, se tawi do fa’i.
 Sai ovi o tori vallinde ha saaro mako be oyechhi be wanni be bayani ko feddata.  Kanjum don saare mako hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acchi sam bawo o naftiri.
Oyidi o anda, dume don o wadata heba ta oringa hurlituko sosai do, to odo hota sare ko to o nani gorko mako do warta? 
Dume don owadata o lornina  hakkilo mako, berde mako waala , jam e hakkilo?
model_answer:
Ɗum ena wayi no **kulol/panic attack walla PTSD** sabu tampere e hunuko/juulde gorko makko; wonaa bonere makko, lekki gargajiya tan alaa jogi ɗum.  
Ko ɓuri arande ko **kisal makko**: so gorko makko ena tappude mo walla o hulii, o yahu nokku koolniiɗo—ɓeyngu, ɗimo, liman/ardo, police/GBV desk walla social welfare—hoto o henti ɗon ɗo haɗari.  
O foti yahude asibiti ngam ɗoktooro walla mental-health/counsellor ƴeewa mo, ɓe hokku mo waajibi, counseling, e lekki anxiety/sveende so ena haani.  
Nde kulol ngol ari, o jooɗo nokku jam, o waɗa henkitaade: nawu heɓa 4, tawa seeɗa, acca 6, o waɗa ɗum laabi seeɗa haa ɓernde makko hoya.  
So o waɗii miijooje bonde hoore makko, walla o waɗi fiiɗugol, woppugol, walla ɓernde/hendu sattii, o yahu asibiti ko jooni.

Daada je wondi ha daadirabe je waddata bikkoi mappe tufugo baatal ofamtini  o ye’u kecchel mako do mari damuwa ha hundeko mako, bo lebol mingel mai o wadi buluu .
Hande sai o yi’i to odo musina bingel mai, odo torra , hebata hendu boddum , be kuma do hokkamo bone foofugo boddum. Ovi kanjum don saklimo sam gam ohanda ko feddata be kecchel mako.
Dumedon watata lebol mingel wada buluu banni? Dume don kuma waddata mingel torra bo heba damuwa foofugo to’ do musina? Lekki don be hokkatanaaa, ko be larai mingel mai na?
model_answer:
Ɓingel so hunduko walla leɓɓe mako ɗon waɗa **blue** e o ɗon torra heɓugo hendu, ɗum ko **haala ɗum ndiyan sembe**—ina waawi wonde jokkondiral ɓernde (congenital heart disease), hendu/puccu, walla nono/njamdi na naati ɗo hendu.  
Ɗum **wonaa huunde nde aɗa ɗaranii lekki suudu**; nawnee mo **hospital gila ɗoo jooni** ngam o heɓa oxygen, dubaaji hendu/ɓernde, X-ray/echo, e lekki ngam infection so woni.  
So o ɗon noni/camooje nde blue ɗon arta, **dartin nono**, jog mo ɗo hoore mako ɓuri ƴeewde, laɓɓin hunduko e ɗumɗum, kadi yawtinee hospital.  
Hoto hokkitee mo ganye walla lekki nde dokita waɗaani, sabu ina waawi ɓurɗe bonnude hendu mako.

question: dada joɗata ha fattude amin ɗo mari redu je ɓingel mako ɗiɗabo ha fuɗɗere redu mai komai o yaha dai- dai o ɗo nana belɗum ɓingel fere ɗo wara amma lewru seɗɗa ko saali ɗo o fuɗɗi nanugo les redu mako ɗo nawa nyande nawɗum mai waɗi mo sossai har dakai o darata boɗɗum neɓai sam ɓawo ton o fuɗɗi rufugo iyam sossai rufugo iyam mai nda no rufata ɗon ba rufi sossai kuma watti mo tuni o do somi nde o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri ta ni ɗon ko fe'i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi valli mo ɓeyahi sibiti ɗemle am kanjum ɗume ɗon watata nawugo les redu haa redujo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo alama hattara ɗon nana jey dada ko ɓingel haa redu may ɗume on alama goɗɗo larata redu may ɗon damuwa ɗon lekki jey darnata nawɗum may na ɓeddarna iyam may jey nawnata ɓingel may
reference: Daada, joodata ha  fattude amin. Do mari redu je mingel mako didabu. A fuddurde reedu mai komai oyaha daidai, odo nana beldum bingel feere do wara . Amma lewru sedda ko saalido ofuddi nanugo les reedu mako do naawa. Yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai, har daker o darata boddum. Nebai sam, bawo toin ofuddi rufugo eyam sosai . Rufugo eyam mai da no rufata don ba, rufi sosai kuma waati mo chomri odo Sommi. Dai o laari eyam mai, sai o hurtili taani don ko fe’di be bingel mako. Gorko mako yawi vallimo be yahi sibiti. Demde am kanju, dume don watata nawugo les reedu ha reedujo? Rufugo eyam sosai do alaama hattara don na je daada ko bingel ha redu mai? Dumedon alaama goddo laarata redu mai don damuwa? Don lekki je darnata naudum mai na be darna eyam mai je nawnata bingel mai?
model_answer:
Eey, ɗum ko **alama haɗari**: nawɗum les reedu + **rufugo “iyam” daga farji** e rufugo sossai/majjaare ɓingel ena waawi wonde **iyam ɓingel (membrane) udditii**, preterm labour/miscarriage walla infection.  
Yo on **naɓa mo sibiti gila jooni**, musamman ɗo gorko mako yahi vallugo mo: a waɗanee scan, a dƴeeɗa ɗaɓɓere ɓingel, cervix, ɗum e infection/urine, ngam ittude haɗari e ɓingel.  
So o yi’i **dammuji (jini), hursere, ɗowre, rufugo iyam woni wari, ɓingel seedataa/dillataa, walla o waawaa yarugo/darugo**, ɗum ko emergency.  
Haa nde on yetta sibiti: **hotoo lekki e ganyen gida**, hotoo jima’i, yo o ɗaɓɓitoo, o yartu ɗiɗi-ɗiɗi so o waawi, o huutoro pad ngam yiyde ko rufata.  
Rufugo iyam e nawɗum ena waawi **naawna ɓingel** so a ɗeɓɓina lewru ko infection waɗi, kono dokitaaji sibiti maa wallita ɗum.

question: likita daada joɗata haa sare amin lari ɓingel maako wala musugo boɗɗum nde o yiɗi o musina mo sey ɓingel may musina seɗɗa sey yofta bana o ɗo somi daada may bo hirliti ɓingel may wala sembe musugo nden bo o ɗo fita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso na kanjum tamba nden bo fofugo ɓingel may canji o ɗo fofa bana yaha dow dow ɓeɗo jippa les les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata wani fofugo ɓalleji ɗo dilla ni dada may o ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel may wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolwa ɓingel may to sey o wi ha o yaha sibiti o lara likita koyninamo ɓingel mako ɗemne am ɗume on latata ɓingel heɓa damuwa musungo boɗɗum no ɓingel may fofata ɗo alama nyamu fere ɗon na alamaji hattara toy dada be ɓaɓa ɓingel may hakkilinta ɗume on wattata ɓingel petel wolwugo to ɗo musina
reference:
Likita, daada joodata ha sare amin, laari mingel mako wala musungo boddum. Dai o idi o musinamo sai mingel mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi. Dada mai bo hirliti bingel mai wala sembe musungo denbo odo fi ta wulina sosai ha hore be yeso. Da kanjum tanba denbo foofugo bingel mai changi. Odo foofa bana yaha do do be do jippa les les , bana goddo mo hokkata bone foofugo. Balleji do dilla ni, daada mai obedda damugo. Odo tamma ko gam bingel mai wala musuna ko heyata ko don damuwa fere je do hauti be foofugo be vulungo bingel mai. Toh sai ovi ha oyaha sibiti olaara likita hauninamo bingel mako. 
 Demde am, dumedon lattata bingel heba damuwa musungo boddum? No bingel mai foofata do, alaama nyawu fere Donna?  Alaamaji hattara toi daada be baaba mingel mai hokkilinta? Dumedon waatata mingel petel vulungo todo musina?
model_answer:
Eey, ɗuum ko **alamaaji hattara**: ɓinngel walaa sembe, no wuli haa hoore/yeso, no fofa dow-dow walla kirji no jippa-les, walla o waawaa haala/nyaama — ɗum ina waawi wonde pneumonia, malaria, infection walla asthma.  
Daada e baaba ɓinngel **njoɗɗee mo asibiti jooni**, hoto ɗon fanɗo e suudu sabu fofugo baylugo e sembe ŋakki ko emergency.  
So ɓinngel heɓii: fittaare no yaasi, ɓernde/kirji no sooyta, ɓeɓɓe/wuro no ɓulaaji, o yimɓi/maaki, o jooni seɗɗa walla o yaltinaa—ɗum ɓuri yaawde.  
Haa nde ɗon yahay, waɗee mo e nokku mo heɓata hennde, hokkee mo nono/ruwa seɗɗa-seɗɗa so o waawi hupa, kono hoto hokku tambaaji ko antibiotics si likita yi’aali.

Ɗum ko hulɓinii: sukaaɗo duuɓi sappo ɗo no mehi sanne, no yarii/ɓaddu sanne, no salii nyaamdu, no laɓɓini, ɓernde makko no metti—ɗum ena waawi wonde sukkari/diabetes, haa “ketoacidosis” ɗe waawi waɗde haɗari.

model_answer:
Ɓingel ngel no waawi jogoraade hawju cellal ndee: nyaamugo wala boɗɗum, lohugo ɓandu/waasa sembe, walla waasa mawnude no feewi.  
Ɓe nawra ngel jooni to suudu cellal mawɗo walla asibiti ngal jogii likita ɓiɓɓe, ngam ɓe ƴeewta ɗaɓɓude haɓɓere, malaria/cuta, jokkondiral ɓernde, ɗoole, anemia, gila e ɓeydugol ɓandu.  
So ngel wala nyamde walla muynude, ngel heɓii fibaare, hendu haaɗi, ɗaɓɓitaaki, walla ngel ɗuɓɓii, ɗum ko ɗawirgol—nawree ngel asibiti hannde.  
Hoto ɓe hokku ngel magani gargajiya walla “sakli” ko a andaa, sabu ɗum waawi ɓeyda bone.  
Debbo duuɓi 43 so o yiɗi ɓeydugol ɓiɓɓe, o waɗa antenatal e asibiti caggal ngam ndiyam reedu e jibinannde mum en laaɓa.

question: debbo ɗo danyi ha amin fajira ɗo veyti ɗo danyi de o wari jambi jeytati be fajira mun wondi be mako hasare yoni amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako do diwna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o ɗo mari damuwaji ko shafi ɓandu mako je damata mo sosai min yahi min lari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolwugo ɓandu mako min tawi 38.2 min wanni mo goɗɗi ɓe nyamu cuufi gam debbo ɗo welnai o nanɗi maleriya min emi mo ko wonɗi ko o nyami o wi wala ko o nyami min yetti mo wonɗi mo wonɗi be mako ɓe hokka mo sha'i o yara min emi mo o musini hande na se o wi de o wari musungo ɓingel may sey o tawi keccel may riwi sey min wi debbo may o umma o joɗa o ɓara ɓawo mako heɓa vallita ɓandu mako hoyna seɗɗa ɗo pat ɗa pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laaɓai min sawri mo to nyamini sai o yara paracetamol to o yari paracetamol mai timmi sai min lara dai ɗon hanɗi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria kuma min waɗi mo goji mai useni min wawan min hokka mo fahin to o timmini yamugo ɗen bo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol tunda o satai to dillai ni min handi yaudi dim min mokamo min hokka to
reference:
Debbo do dayi ha amin fajira do. Veeti do o dayi. Dai owari jambi je tati be fajiri , mo wondi be mako ha sare yooni amin, vi debbo do bandu mako do duina bo do vuli sosai denbo odo mari damuwaaji ko shafi bandu mako je daamata sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai, min suddi mo be kare, mi hauni wulugo bandu mako, min tawi 38.2.
Min wanni mo goji be nawu chufi. Kam debbo do velnai, o nandi malariya . Min emmi mo ko woodi ko o yaami, ovi wala ko Oyami. Min yechi mo vondi be mako, be hokkamo shaa’i o yara. Min emmimo o musini hande na? Sai ovi dai owari musungo bingel mai, sai o tawi kecchel mai riiwi.
Sai minvi debbo mai o umma o hoods obaara bawo mako , heba vallita bandu mako hoina sedda da pat ba, amma vallitai bo gite mako Labai. Min sauri mo to yamini sai oyara paracetamol. To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. To o timmini yamugo, denbo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol, tunda o saatai, to dillai ni minhandai yaudinde min hokkata.
model_answer:
Ɗum waawi wonde malaria, amma so debbo ɗo waɗii musungo/ɓingel heɓii koɗɗol walla o ɗo mari metere reedu, jiiɓol, ɗamol/foɗɗere bonɗe, walla gite laaɓaaki—ɗum ko haɗari, yahee mo suudu cellal/hospital jooni.  
Awa waɗee test malaria (RDT) e test ciki, urine, Hb, e aune vital signs; hoto hokkite dawa malaria tawa test waɗaaka.  
So malaria tabitii, hokkitee ACT (artemether-lumefantrine) so o wonaani ciki; so o woni ciki, dokita/CHO suudu cellal waɗa dawa ngam ciki.  
Paracetamol 1g (500mg biyu) kala awaaji 6–8, hoto ɓuri 4g e nyalnde, e o yar ɗiyam, o nyaam seɗɗa-seɗɗa.  
So o woppii, o majjii, o heɓii jiiɓol/metere reedu, fever 39+, walla o waawataa yara/nyaama—refer emergency.

question: daniel e kesum ko daniel e ha azibiti amin minti chappan de didi ko wadi bingel gel ena wadi nodum danye woyayi woyayi ta min yali noden danya gel wadayi woyande boddum min yiwi mufanago mako tidum nowadu kono bingel gel ena yidi ta min yiwi kadi tambereji mako tidum no ala chedele namle mako kodume wawi dami ɓingel kesum wadi no dum dami haa wayai en wadai wadade boɗɗum gele de danya har no je jamu wala jokkoderal darajagal ɓingel gel foti heɓɓe inna o warti wuro en ɓingel gel koɗume o wawi koɗum hokkude ɓingel gel sey ko ɗume o wawa hokkude har irin nyamdu inna ma nyamdu gam o wanna en jam tiɓɓingel gel ma waɗi en jam

Ɓinngel kesum so o wulira seeɗa, ɗum waawi wonde ko nälgu/hiɓɓere, kono so woyde ɓuri, o sala muɗɗude, o hulii/ɓeydi ɗumnde, o heɓii fiva, o nawni hendu, walla ɓernde/huunde makko ɓuri mawɗude, ndeen wartinee asibiti jooni.

Mi waawataa waɗde hukunci tawa mi ƴeewaali bingel on, amma ndiyam/ɗuɗal e ɓandu/reedu, canjagol daande, tampere e nawnugo les-reedu waawi ummaade e cutaaji koda/kidney, ɓernde, hanta, rashin protein/kwashiorkor, allergy, infection, ko constipation/UTI/worms/appendix.  
Hinaa dayugo tan waddata nawnugo reedu; so dayugo woodaani kadi waɗi ɗum waawi wonde ko ɗii ɗum.

So o hosa henndu, reedu makko ɓeydata, jonte/ɓandu ɗuɗi, o ronki ñaamde/yarude, fitsari famɗi, ko nawnugo ɓuri—yaha emergency jooni.  
Hoto hokku mo magani gargajiya walla painkillers kamar ibuprofen ba tare da likita ba; famɗin gishiri, hokku ñaamdu moƴƴere, ndeen follow-up.

question: debbo feere kam waddi ɓinge makko mo duuɓi tati asibiti ɓe laara mo hande subaka koɓe haali bo hikke to yimɓe wolwani ɓinge on o tannitataako sam o laarata goɗɗo feere mo wolwalta mo hetaano di'in de makko o sonyata mo daamayi hano o nane maasaba hindere ƴamoyi ngoyme ƴamidebbo on jukale omme ɗi higuguɓa tena e namakko wi o me daya hebike badde membedi mem tsamimo jukale ngoya hebi jabugo galapate be sode mun hatimude ko ofotino hebigo bana non inna makko waddi ereji nyawudugol dum min kotorto labini min ge on jabi bate makkosa but min bedi min tsami ko feti hunde jukale on ingol wala padde e o jabi bate pesode makko pat ko dami jukale on

model_answer:
Jukalel ngel no e haala nyawu mawɗo: ko o heɓi nguleendi, o waawataa jaabaade, gite/ɓalli mum no wayi haaɗi—ɗum ena waɗi min tuuma **malaria tiiɗnde (cerebral malaria)** walla **meningitis/sepsis**, hara ɗum ko gollal jaawngal.  
Ɗum hinaa padde/epilepsy tan haa min ƴeewi mo; min waɗata sukaru ƴiiƴam, test malaria, PCV, ƴiiƴam ɗiɗi, e ƴeewtagol meningitis so ena woodi.  
Pawtugol jaawngol: toppitagol ndiyam/oxygen so ena woodi, diazepam so o naŋgi, dextrose so sukaru leydi, **IV artesunate** ngam malaria tiiɗnde, e **ceftriaxone** ngam meningitis/sepsis.  
Hoto ɓe naatnu mo ɗaɗi walla kosam/lekki saare nde o waawataa ɗaɓɓude, sabu ena waawi naatde henndu e ɓernde.  
O foti wonde e asibiti, ɓe reena mo haa o yahrata e anndal e nguleendi leɗɗi.

question: ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hanɗe fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha mako sosai fa kuma ɗo sakli mo ɗa seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o wi meɗi feɗugo ɗe ɗiɗi ko sali ɗe fe'ata o ɗo nana nauɗum den bo iyam mai rufata a rufata be emi ko reɗu ɗon rufata o wi o anda ko oɗon mari reɗu ko oɗo be reɗu be emi dai o lari al'ada mako o wi neɓai ko o lari o wi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo em ɗo fuɗɗi dai hande fajira useni ɗume on watata debbo rufugo em sosai ɗo banni mataki geggewal toi hosata yahu ndigi toi hokkata debbo ɗo hisnu yonki mako be darnata emmai lekkiji toi be bateji toi be hokkatamo je darnata emmai
reference:
Be waddi debbi fere sibiti hande fajira do, eyam do rufa ha mako sosai fah, kuma do sakli mo daa sedda. Be demi mo, ko irin do meddi fudugo be mako, ovi medi fudugo de didi ko saali. De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? Mataki gwagaawal toi hosata? Yaudigi toi hokkata debbo do hisnu yonkimaako be darnata eyam mai?
Lekkiji toi be baatedi toi be hokkatamo je darnata eyam mai?
Kuma hownugo toi be waawata be wadda, be hefta dume waddi rufugo eyam kulnidum do?
model_answer:
Ruɓugo ɗam heewngo e debbo hono ɗum ko **golle gorko (emergency)**: haalaaji mum ina mbaawi wonde **ɓolugol reedu (miscarriage), reedu ɗo ngal wonaa ka maha (ectopic), walla cuta/ciɓtorgal ka reedu**, sabu o wi’i al’ada mako waɗii lewru gooto tan.  

Mataki aduna: **ɗaɓɓitanee BP/pulse**, wallaade mo, waɗee **IV cannula ɗiɗi**, hurminee **normal saline/Ringer’s lactate**, ɗaɓɓitee ɗam ngam **cross-match/transfusion** so ɗam ɗon rufa sosai.  

Ɗaɓɓitee **pregnancy test** e **ultrasound**; so o woni e reedu ngam ɗo nawa e ɓernde/ciɗɗol, **ectopic rupture** ina jogii haɗari—yahat ko ɗo theater/likita OB-GYN jooni.  

So ko ɓolugol reedu walla ɗam ina heddii ka maha, aɗa waawi hokka **misoprostol** walla waɗa **MVA/evacuation** e antibiotics so infection woni; so o rufi ɗam heewi, **tranexamic acid 1g IV** e transfusion ina wallita.  

Hoto neeɓnee: noddee ambulance/referral to babban asibiti ɗo ɗam, ultrasound, theater e likitan mata woni, sabu yonki mako ina waawi haɓɓude.

Koste mako didi be juude mako be yeso fu pat ni do puuti puuti. Odo tani habda be mai. Be saurimo o yara hundeji fere nii, amma dai fu pat walaa ko hoini sam. Amma nii be viimo o tammi waddugo daama.
Be laari mo bevi daa ko shafii foofugo don ba. Ko haadini beda be wadi, be vii da kodume manga don bah. Odo fada eskal wala bone. Sembe eyam mako fu be hauni be tawi 168/100.  Gammai bevi o suita , be godi sembe eyam mako fain be tawi 150/90.
Belaari bo odo bee reedu. Toh sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe eyam mako do fadi, je marbe reedu, gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumo reedujo. Be yechi mo kala hundeji fu je owatta, bandamo hundeji tornato mo soosai  watata sembe eyam mako bedda. Demde am ba, bawo hundeji be wanni irin jaumu reedu do, jedo mari nawwugo hoore kullum be uppugo yeeso mataaki toi hosata hado reedujo do, ta  ye’u yotta har debbi mo do jima?
Be kuma dume don jaumu redu wadata da yotta irinbanni bako owonna banni?
model_answer:
Sembe iyam 168/100 walla 150/90 ko ɓurɗo, ina waawi waɗude namugo hoore, muuyde, ɗanndugo jamma e ɓuuti-ɓuuti, amma haani ɓe ƴeewto mo no feewi haa ɓe calmina stroke, suga, nyawu ɓernde/reewɓe, kidney walla pre-eclampsia so debbo o jogii reedu.  
O waɗu lekki sembe iyam ɗin no dokita hokki, o yaltina salte, maggi, mai-jewu, sigara/kola, o yara ndiyam, o foofa, o ɗaɓɓita BP mako subaka e jamma haa balɗe seeɗa.  
So BP mako yotti 180/120 walla o heɓi namugo hoore mawɗo, yiyde ɓolɗe, sembe juɗe/koyɗe ɗiɗi ɗon lutta, haala ɗon bonna, ɓernde ɗon metta, wonde ɗon waɗa mo, walla o faɗi—ɓe naw mo asibiti jooni-joni.  
So o jogii reedu, ko waɗi namugo hoore e uppugo yeeso, ɗum ko gawatiri; o yaha asibiti jooni ngam ƴeewtugo protein e fitsari e reedu.  
Hade nyawu yotta, ko ndokkitaajo rewata mo, o joga lekki no feewi, o auna BP kullum, o waɗa gwaje-gwaje ɗin, o acca waɗugo lekki ɗin ko faamugo dokita.

question: ɓawo mi danyi ɓandu am fuɗɗi hoynugo kikiɗe fere ni mi numi tunda dai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam hafa to de am to mi yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum diyam ɓeddoti mi naftirta mi numi am hafa handi ni ɓiɗo hakkina hore am miɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigide fere bo wari mi nanai belɗum ɓandu am mi fuɗɗi nanugo jahagol be ɓandu am fuɗɗi diwunugo kullum kullum da miɗo nana jagol bo hauti be ɓandu am belɗum feyin semi hirliti iyam jey vurtata ɓawo daigo ɗon haccega minanata daga totton bo velai bo haccega mayi ɗuɗi bo meɗai feɗugo beyam mikasi ittugo gite am daga totton demi ummi sai ɗon miyahi sibiti mi'ema ko ndiyam labɗam jemi naftirta miyiwa bemai kamjum on wadda takalayam bawo daygo
reference: Bawo mi dayi , bandu am fuddi hoinugo , kikide fere ni minumi, tunde dai en wala diam labdam ha fattude amin, to idi mi yiiwa kullum kullum diam be dotti , minaftirita , mi numii amma fah haadi ni mido hakkilona hore am mido yiiwa boddum. Toh kikide fere bo wari , mi nanei beldum bandu am. Mi fuddi nanugo jaagol , be bandu am fuddi dewnugo kullum kullum . Da mido naana jaagol, bo hauti be bandu am vellai fein. Se mi hirliti eyam je vurtata bawo dayugo don hacchega mi nannata daga ton bo vellai bo. Hacchega mai duudi bo meddai fudugo be am  bo. Mi kaasi ittugo gite am daga totton. Dai mi ummi, sai don miyahi sibiti mi emma ko diyam labdam je mi naftiri ta mi yiwa be mai kanjum don waddata kala yeu bawo dayugo.
model_answer:
Ɗum ko waawi wonde **hurum-hurum/allergie ɓandu**, walla **cukkuli (scabies)**/infection ɓandu, ko ndiyam ɗi laaɓaani, saabunde walla sewnde naawnuɗe ɓandu ngaddi.  
Hoto njiyataa ndiyam bonɗam: **suuɗu/taaƴu ndiyam, seyɗin/boil ɗum**, walla huutora chlorine/tablet ɗi jeyaa, kadi njangu colte e leppi ɗi jeyaa.  
So ɗum ko cukkuli, ɓandu ena nyaama ko jaɓɓi ma, soɗɗi ma e ɓesngu maa ena waɗi, ɗum waɗata ngam **Permethrin 5% cream** e ɓandu fuu jamma, kadi ɓe njangu leppi fuu.  
A waawi huutora **cetirizine 10mg jamma** ngam nyaamgol ɓandu, kono so ɓandu ena wufti, ena waɗi puccu, nguleeki, ɗolle gite, walla nyaamgol ngol ɓurti, **yah sibiti** ngam daktari hollita ma.  
Hoto njoggo ɓandu haa ɓurti, sabu ɗum waawi naatnude infection.

question: addirawo am danyi ɓinngel debbo balɗe saali sey o laari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo wala foofa boɗɗum wakkati feere ɓinngel man yofta kosam bamo fofɗe maako ta'i yande woore daada ɓinngel timmini musungo mo bee jemma sey o laari leɓɓi ɓinngel ba wala ba wayliti seɗɗa seɗɗa sey o tampi ko o waɗata sey o goɗi ɓamtugo ɓinngel man ngam o heɓa o foofa boɗɗum ammaa bo ɓinngel gaagiri foofugo boɗɗum bee boo canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel man sey o yaawi o hoosi ɓinngel o yaari asibiti ngam ɓe laaranamo ɓinngel may ɗume on canjini ɓinngel man leɓɓal nden bo walaa aybe no ɓinngel foofata na ko bo nyawuɓe nde walla nyawu hanta dasinta ɓinngel man foofugo bee bone ɗume on alaamaaji kalluɗum jee saarooji waatinta hakkiilo ɗume on agaji ɓe waawata hokkugo ɓinngel mo foofata bee bone
reference:
Addirawo am dayi bingel debbo balde sali ,sai o lari ba kala wakkati o misinta mo o wala fofa boddum,wakkati fere bingel man yofta ta kossam bamo pofde mako ta ee,yenda wore,dada bingel timmini musungo mo be jemma,sai o lari lebbi bingel ba wailiti sedda sedda,sai o tampi ko o wadata,sai o godi bamtugo bingel mai gam o heba o fofa boddum,amma bo bingel gagiri fofugo boddum,be bo chanjugo lebbi bingel man,sai o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be larinamo bingel mai,
Dume on chanjini bingel man lebbal?
Denbo wala aibe no bingel fofata nah?
Ko bo yauw berde walla yauw hanta dasinta bingel man fofata be bone?
Dume on alamaji kalludum je saaroji watinta hakkilo 
Dume on aagaji be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone
model_answer:
Ɗum mo on haalata — ɓinngel no tampi foofugo, leɓɓi no canja/ɓaleeji, tee o tampata wakkati muyannde — **ko alaama kalluɗum**, wonaa ko ɓinngel “waawi ɗum” no feewi.  
Sababuuji waawi wonde **nyawu hanta/pneumonia walla infection/sepsis**, **nyawu ɓernde tawi ko jibinaaɗo**, walla **ɗaɓɓere/kine ko udditii** ngam kosam na yaltina e kine.  
Yiyde leɓɓi walla ɗemngal no ɓaleeji, foofugo yaawngo, ɓanndu no naata, o waawaa muyannde, o tampii walla o jooɗii no ɗowtinii—ɗii fof ko alaamaaji ɗe waɗata on yaade **asibiti jooni-jooni**.  
Ko on waawi waɗude hade on yotta: **ɗowtin ɓinngel**, waɗ mo e nder ɗumɗum, humtin hoore seɗɗa, laɓɓin kine/huunde no leelɗum so ina jogii ɗiiɗi, tee **hoto hokku kosam so o tampi foofugo**.  
Asibiti ɓe waawi hokkude **oxygen**, laara ɓernde e hanta, ɗeƴƴinde infection, tee hokkude safaraaji ɗi heɓata ndeen waɗnde.

question: debbo jomu redu reduma lebbi jewego minɗo wondi saare gotel fuɗɗi hirugo dow ɓernde maako ɗo fiya be lawlaw a viya mo timmini doggugo jottam wakkati fere bo oɗo soma ko o huway ko ɗume debbo jungo maako ɗo hawtidira seɗɗa satiji saali seɗɗa o lari dande maako ɗo uppa hedi yeso sai o hultiri oɗo numa ɗo kam ɗo nder nyawu damata jomu redu na ko bo ɗum nyawu fere on sai o taski nyawugo lara likita ngam o anda ɗume sanadu nyawɗo emol haɗo ɗume on waddini debbo redujo ɗo fiyal ɓerde be law law ɗo a viya mo timmini doggugo nden bo ɗume on sanadu uppugo dande ɗo nden bo irin nyawu ɗo kam wawan mema mawnugo ɓingel redu mako ɗo na ɗume on alamaji kalluɗum je ɓe wattinta gite hasare ba irin nyawu ko kuje yareyareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko ɓeddata nyawugo ha irin wakkati ɗo
reference:
Debbo Jomu redu reduman lebbi jego,mindo wondi sare gotel,fuddi hirrugo do berde mako do fiya be lau lau,aviya mo timmini dongugo jotta,wakkati fere bo o do soma ko o huwai ko dume,denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda,satiji sali sedda o lari dade mako do uppa heddi yeso,sai o hultiri,o do nummado kam do der yauwu damata jomu redu nah ko bo dum yauwu fere on,sai o taski yehugo lara likita gam andugo dume sanadu yauw do.
Yammol ha do ,dume on waddini debbo redujo do fiyal berde be lau lau do aviya bo timmini doggugo?
Denbo dumme sanadu uppugo dade do?
Denbo irin yauw do kam wawan meme maunugo bingel redu mako do nah?
Dume on alamaji kalludum je be watinta gite ha sare?
Baa Irin yamduji ko kuje yare yare ji on hadi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko o bedda ta yammugo ha irin wakkati do?
model_answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi—ɓernde fiyude law, jungo ɗi dimbude, yareede/huutorgo, e uppugo dande yeeso—ɓuri yiɗde no nyawu **thyroid/goitre (hyperthyroidism)**, wonaa ko reedu tan; haa noon anemia, malaria walla BP toowiɗo maɓɓe mbaawi waɗde ɗum.  
O haani yaade asibiti/likita gila jooni ngam waɗde **BP, PCV/Hb, malaria test, urine protein, TSH e Free T4**, e ƴeewde ɓingel.  
So thyroid ɗum ɗo fiiɗi, ina waawi waɗde haɗari: ɓernde debbo tampude, ɗaɓɓude ɗeeɗe, reedu yaade ko jaango, ɓingel mawnataa no feewi, walla ɓingel jogiɗe thyroid problem.  
Ɗum ina wondi lekki kisɗi e reedu so likita hokki: **PTU** ko methimazole (no wakkati reedu), e lekki ɓernde lawlaw ko wardi seɗɗa; hoto o huutoro lekki goitre ko yare-yareji tawa likita wallaani.  
So o heɓii honto faa o semmbitii, o ɗaɓɓi henndu, o fainti, ƴiƴam wari, ɓingel yiltataa, walla hoore mawni/BP toowi—ɗum ko emergency, yaa asibiti ɗon ɗon.

question: mi hakkili miko amperti domo vowi fiji gobe so birabe mako canji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan judo taya sudu mako kullum o acce yauta gobo o wala fala ko vowi hidigo mi hakkili bo komi ninje woni sare o yidai nyamugo be amin odon andi mo woni dar billa ko chomri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata mettol berde on na ko torruko hakkilo on damata mun hertoi min wawata vallugo mun gam seyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko shawara na ko likita mon den yahu jeberde
reference: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Wawan lata mettol berde on na koh torrugo hakkilo on damata mo? Her toi min wawata vallugo mo gam seyo mako warta? Beh alamaji toi handi en hakkila? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
model_answer:
Ko canjitagol ɗoŋkaaji/hakkillo ɗum ɗo ardi sket, e nattugol ñaamde, yahrugol e sudu, walla mettol ɓernde/loygol ɓandu, ko **haaju jaɓɓugol ɗum ko jooni e asibiti**—ina waawi wonde *delirium*, malaria, infection ɗeɗɗi/nyiiɓre, sukkari ƴi’ude/ɓurnde, stroke, walla matsalar ɓernde.  
To mettol ɓernde, nofugol, ɗemngal bonde, junngo/koyngal ɗiɗi leydi, walla o waawaa haalde no feewi, **yahɓe gawatir/emergency**.  
Hokkugo ɗum yamiroore: ndeen ɗum e nokkuure nde hisi, hokkoyee ndiyam seeɗa so o woodi hakkillo, kono **hoto doolee ñaamde walla lekki**.  
Ɗaɓɓitee likita yo ƴe ƴeewto hitaande, BP, sukkari, malaria, urine, infection, e ɓernde, ngam waɗde ballal moƴƴal.  
Ardinee lekki ɗum o naati e ɗum, e no canjitagol ɗum fuɗɗori, ngam likita walla.

question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer:
Ɓingel lewru tati ɗo mari tari/cough, nange walla fofa no yaawi, walla o salii muusnugo/ɗaanugo, ɗum ko alama ɗo waawi wonde mura/bronchiolitis walla pneumonia; o waɗa e likita hannde.  
To fofa mako yaawi, ɓernde/ɗiɗi mako na naata e nder, o na wiiɗa, o salii muusnugo, o na yiɗa ɗaanude tan, walla ɗiɗi mako na moƴƴi blu/ɓaleeji—ndeen ko gawat, jaha asibiti jooni.  
A waawi waɗude: hokku nono ɗumɗum, waɗu ruwan gishiri/saline e hanci kadi huutora bulb/safa laaɓal ngam udditde hanci, waɗu mo ɗow-ɗow so o ɗaani, haɗa mo e hayaaki/ƙura.  
Hoto hokku “cough syrup”, antibiotics, walla leppi gida tawa likita yi’aali, sabu ɗi waawi waɗude haɗari e ɓiɓɓe rewru tati.  
So nange waɗi, paracetamol ɗum no waawi hokkeede e dose nde likita/ma’aikacin lafiya holli, amma ko ɓuri muhimmu ko duba mo e asibiti.

question: rawandu gati bingel banɗan dubi mako jeɗiɗi de rawandu mai gati mo e yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta'i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum a foro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuɗɗi wurtugo namputure bo ɓuti e yecci ɓe yara mo asibiti useni iri kalariroye toy e wannata ɓingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo wutandu gam rawandu may koda rawandu may ɗo dama bo iri sabandi toy hani e wanna ɓingel petel ɗo mandoro wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer:
Nyaawre rawandu ko heɓeede haasidi: ɓe njaha asibiti jooni, ɓe lootira fernde ndiyam e saabulu, ɓe ittira lekki gargajiya ɗii, ɓe waɗa dressing.  
Bingel maa hokkire **allurar rabies** jooni (post‑exposure vaccine); so ɓaawo/ɓandu fernde ko mawnde walla rawandu mayii, o haani heɓude **rabies immunoglobulin** e fernde nde.  
O haani kadi heɓude **allurar tetanus** so ɗum waɗaako ɗoo, e **antibiotic** ngam hana namputure/pus.  
Rabies so fuɗɗii alamaaji, ko ɗum waɗata maayde; sabu ɗum, waasde waɗde gargajiya tan—asibiti ko ɗo hani.  
So rawandu on mayii, ɓe mbaɗa ɗum ha biro lafiya/animal health ngam ndaarndu, amma ɗum waasata haɗde fuɗɗaade allurar rabies.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Ɗum ina nanndi e **dimbugo zazzabi (febrile convulsion)**, kono e ɗo men woni, zazzabi fitiiɗo ina waawi wonde **malaria** walla nyawu goɗɗo.  
So ɓingel dimbii, waɗu mo e wettere, artir hoore mako e ɗoɗɗo, **hoto naatnu hay huunde e hunduko**, hoto jogitoo mo sembe.  
So dimbugol ɓuri **minit 5**, walla o dimbii feere-feere, walla o yaltataa hakkilo, jahu **asibiti ɗoo ɗoo**.  
Ɓingel haani ndaaraneede: malaria test, sukaru zazzabi, nyawu nder heɓɓere/hoore, ngam heɓde lekki moƴƴi.  
Jokkondiral: huutora net ɗiɗi, reenu ɓingel e zazzabi, waɗu paracetamol no dokita wi’i, tee hoto hokku lekki dimbugo tawa dokita woodaani.

question: dada musunowo hirliti ɓingel mako kuma o ɗo lara ni ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo ɗo wula wakkati go dada lori vi'i o yi ɓawo awa seɗɗa sali oyi ɓanɗu ɓingel may gabaki ɗaya tiiɗi sai o faɗɗi bo o anda ko labol mako ɗo maɓɓi gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo wurtinamo ha hunduko kuma ɗingel may wawa ta moɗa kalan yiri fu jotta o ɗo emma irikita ko irin ɗo mara dama kuma be irin yau toyi ganandi ko o wawan o heɓa ɓatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon be naftirta ɓingel be irin yauɗo ha leyol o vurti
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.

Ɗum no wa’i no **kirkita/seizure** e ɓinngel, ina waawi jogoraade sabu **zazzabi/malaria, meningitis, ko rashin glucose**, tee ɗum ko haɗari.  
Awa **ɓennu ɓinngel ɗon jooni to asibiti ko emergency**, ngam a yi’i dokita, a ƴeewta zazzabi, malaria, jini/glucose, tee a hokke dawaaji kaɗi.  
So kirkita waɗii, **woto a naɓɓu huunde e hunduko makko**, woto a waɗu sabulu/gargajiya; ɗakku mo e gefe, ittira huunde ngo waawi haɓɓude mo, tee a waɗu mo no o waawa hokkaade hendu.

Ɗiyam wonɗi e hunduko/ɓusa, ɓanndu tiiɗi, walla o ñaamataa ɗum fow ko alamaji ɗi ina yiɗi **jokkondiral gaggawa**.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer:
Ɗum ko **alamomin haɗari**: rufugo ndiyam/nyamdu e sembe, loleede sosai, juɗe e kosɗe ɗon ɓoɓɓi walla ɓaleeji, saali, e ɓingel mo waawataa nyamugo/yarugo.  
Alaa ɗum wondi e “lekki rufugo” tan; ena waawi wonde **malaria mai tsanani, ciwon ciki/hanji, meningitis/sepsis, dehydration, ko matsala e hoore**—sabboda ɗum o sokli asibiti jooni.  
Likita yo waɗu gwaje-gwaje: **malaria test, PCV/Hb, sugar, electrolytes**, e duba dehydration; o waawi heɓde **ruwa ta jiiɓgol (IV fluids), antimalarial/antibiotic**, walla aɗa tippu zuwa babban asibiti so fontanelle/hoore ɗon ɓolla walla rufugo ɗon jokkude.  
Nder ɗum, so o hakkilanta, waɗan mo **ORS ndogo-ndogo** e ciigari, jokkondir ɓamtaare, kono **hoto mo nyamdu sembe-seembe** e hoto kuugal lekki gargajiya.  
So o ɗon loleede, ɗon ɗaɓɓude, wala yaha jiiɓgol, walla rufugo kala ko o yarii—**naatnu mo emergency yanzu-yanzu**.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam feuɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo

Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.

Ɗum ko **hauju mawɗo**: ɓingel hirlitii walla hakkille mum wayaani, fofugo mum bo wayaani daidai.

So o dartii fofde, fuɗɗo **CPR** so a anndii, walla noddu ballal jeyaaɓe caafima.

Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko haala mawɗo: bingel labbi joyi/jeego jogii dojjere balɗe 13–14, reedu ɓurii, walaa waawi fofa, e goje-goje caggal lekki—yahitee sibiti/ward bingel’en jooni, hoto tawatara ka suudu.  
Hoto hokkitir lekki dojjugo walla lekki a anndaa, tee so goje-goje ngal arii caggal lekki, dartin lekki ngal, ngal waawi wonde allergy.  
So bingel on waawi muuyde, hokkee nono inna ɓuri, e ORS kaɗan-kaɗan: sachet gooto e liitar 1 ndiyam laɓɓam, hokkugo e cokali/cup; zinc 10 mg ñalnde kala balɗe 10–14 waawi wallude dojjere.  
Amma sabu o walaa waawi fofa/reedu ɓurii, o ena hasiira drip, ɗaɓɓitannde infection/malaria, ndiyam jiiɗɗam e ɗaɓɓitannde stool/electrolytes.  
Ɗon ngoɗɗaa, hoto hokku “diyam gora” walla maganin gargajiya, sabu ɗum waawi ɓeydude musiba.

model_answer:
Ɗum ko alama haɗari: debbo reedu lewru 5 so o nana metti nder leyru/ɓawo, njaltol diyam walla ƴiiƴam, walla metti no ndogol, ena waawi wonde ɓangol gite reedu, ndiyam reedu njaltiri, walla infection.  
Hara on waɗaama ɗum, on njoɓa mo ɗoo e ɗoo to suudu likita/kiliniki mawɗo ɗo ɗoctor rewɓe (maternity/obstetric) woni, ko jooni; hoto on ɗaɓɓu mo to galle.  
So on ɗillata, yo o waasa yahde e hoore mako: ɗaɓɓee ambulance walla mota nde o jooɗii/ɗanii e wetto, kadi yo gooto rewɓe rewta mo.  
Hoto on waɗu jimaare, hoto on naatnu huunde nder debbo, waɗee pad laaɓɗo ngam yiyde ƴiiƴam/diyam, ndokkee mo ndiyam so o waawi yara.  
So ƴiiƴam heewi, o fiyii, o heɓi ngulɗam, walla o waawi alaa hokkude, ɗum ko gila-gila—yahaa emergency jooni.

model_answer:
Titilola, so ɓinngel maa ɗo waɗi zazzaɓi teddungal e dande mako ɗo metti/walata o waawi yiiltude walla jokkude, ɗum ko alama haɗari—ina waawi wonde meningitis walla infection teddungal, hinaa zazzaɓi biasa tan.  
Njaaɓu: ndokkaa mo yarata ndiyam/ORS seeɗa-seeɗa so o ɗo fitta, ndokkaa paracetamol no fotiri e ɗoctor/weight, kono woto ndokkaa aspirin walla magani ganye.  
Ko ɓuri moƴƴude, yahdu mo asibiti/ER hande-hande ngam ɓe ƴeewto malaria, infection, dande, e ɗumɗum ɓe ndokku antibiotics ko fluids so wajibi.  
So o ɗo ɗaɓɓita, ɗo waɗi seizure, ɗo yiɗi ɗaanude sosai, ɗo wutsa sanne, walla o waawaa yara/nyaama—ɗum ko gaggawa no feewi.

question: dada fere hakkili layi ɓingel mun do dojja jey balɗe arindiri kam o tamma pewol on billata ɓerde ɓingel man nden bo accan mo amma bo dojjugo man ustai ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam dojjara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bana o wala wawa fofa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini ɓingel man darni o ɗo wawa nana no ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata ngam bannin ɗanugo be jamma ɗo yarna ɓingel man bone nde ɓingel man ɗojji sosai hagagiri mo fofugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tasi gewugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojjugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo bo fuɗɗe man dende bo o anda hedi o wawata wallugo emol am ha ɗo kanjum on ɗumi on wawata wadda ɗojjere be ta'ol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma kuje kalluɗum toi e handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man o dojja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man gam o usta ko haɗa dojjugo man
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko alama haɗɗude: ɗojjere ndee e fofugo tiiɗngo/no ɓernde fiyata waawi wonde pneumonia, asthma/wheezing walla infection ɗum joganii bincike asibiti.  
To ɓingel ɗo habda fofugo, ɓernde ɗo naata/ɗo yalta, o waawataa yarude/ɓamude, o ɗo fuuɗi walla huntuɗe makko ɗo ɓeewi—ndaaru mo asibiti jooni, hoto ɗabbii jango.  
Hade nde njahaa, waɗ mo no o wonira ɗoɓɓere/upright, hokku mo ndiyam walla ɓamugo seeɗa-seeɗa, laɓɓin nokkuure makko be saline/ndiyam ɗanɗanɗe, tee hisnu mo e duule, wuuru, e sigari.  
Hoto hokku ta’al pofɗe, magani ɗojjere, walla antibiotics so dokita yamiraani, sabu ɗum waawi bonnude ɓingel.  
Asibiti ɓe ndaarata fofugo, fever, oxygen, tee ɓe hokku inhaler walla antibiotics so ɗum waɗi haaju.

question: renowo ɓingel laari ɓingel may ɗo docca sosai nauɗum har karshe doccugo mingel nonnon tan fofugo daker toh ɗume ɗon waɗata doccugo haa ɓingel bannin tan har karshe doccugo may wala fofa boɗɗum daker daker fofata goji ɗume be ɗume ɓe wawata ɓe wanna ɓingel ɗo coɓoraaɗe toy min hokkata mo be kuma shawara toy hokkata reenuwo ɓingel may

Kuma shawara toi hokkata renoodo bingel mai?
model_answer:
Ɗum ena wayi no **ɓingel ɗon chokii**: nyaamdu walla huunde tokosere naati ɗaɗol, ɗum haɗi fofugo.  
Si o hara ena docca walla woya, accitee mo o doccu; hoto hokku ndiyam/nyaamdu, hoto naatnu jungo e hunduko.  
Si o waawataa fofa: ɓingel les hitaande 1—waɗee **ɗabɓe 5 e takko** e **tiiɗgol kirji 5**; si o ɓurii hitaande 1—waɗee **ɗabɓe 5 e takko** e **Heimlich/tiiɗgol reedu**.  
Si o majjii walla o bonii, fuɗɗo CPR so aɗa waawi, ɗaɓɓu wallitorde gaggawa, njahaa asibiti/kiliniki ɓadiiɗo ko jaawɗum.  
Shawara: reenoo ɓingel tawa o nyaamataa ko hawrataa huunde tokosere, kono hoto accitee mo e groundnut, kobo, kankana, walla wasaaji tokosuuji.

model_answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaru haɗiiɗum ɓawo jibingol: sembe alaa, gite yi’ataa laaɓi e ɗoyɗeende ina waawi wonde ƴiiƴam ɗuuɗum yaltinii mo, BP ɗowii, sukaru lownii walla infection.

To o waawi lumude, o wurtataa, hokkee mo yi’am walla ORS/kaɓilungo yi’am seɗɗa-seɗɗa, kadi hokkee mo nyiri newiriɗi: kunu/akamu, miya, shinkafa, wake, kifi/nama.  
Si ƴiiƴam ɗuuɗum ɗo yalta, o ɗo faint, o heɓii fits, hoore mettii, o ɗo honyugo walla fever, ɗum ko gawat—ngarnee mo asibiti yaasi.
